title: Pixelator
techniques: point sampling: a background magnified 100,000 times shows one colour per tile
column and row from sibling-index() with mod() and round()
round() snaps neighbouring tiles to one sample, so blocks grow without touching the markup
block size as a registered integer that animates in steps
tile count from sqrt() of the photo's aspect ratio
hover wipe with a one-way opacity transition
a small script swaps in your own photo (object URL, never uploaded)

features.name: sibling-index()
features.baseline: newly available (2026-08-18); the script writes --i where it is missing, and without either the frame shows the plain photo

features.name: CSS round() and mod()

inspiration.title: Michelangelo's David, Florence 2019 (the default photo, CC BY 2.0, resized)

exceptions.script: scene.js swaps the photo for one the visitor picks, drops or pastes, and writes --i where sibling-index() is missing. The pixelation itself is CSS.
exceptions.rasterImage: assets/david.jpg (800x1200 JPEG, 94 KB) is the default photo, asked for by the founder on 2026-11-10. It loads as a separate file and is not part of the 14 KiB page budget.
